votes.question: On Passage — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: This bill generally bars members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks, and it requires public notice before they sell. A Yea passes it in the House. A Nay votes against passage.

votes.question: On Motion to Recommit — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: The Stop Insider Trading Act would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. This vote would have replaced that bill with a broader ban that also forces members, the President, the Vice President, and their spouses and dependent children to sell covered investments they already hold. A Yea would have made that swap; a Nay kept the original bill.

posts.text:
Americans just made their voices heard loud and clear at the ballot box. 

Join our Telephone Town Hall tomorrow, November 17, at 7 PM to continue making your voice heard as we discuss the priorities ahead for the new Congress and the critical issues facing our communities. https://t.co/BhbXfXZSZV
This is all we know at this time. https://t.co/0IiP1BaPKF

The most expensive way to build a White House ballroom is to say it’s free to the American taxpayer, and then sell off federal policy decisions.

Nvidia gave $25 million to the ballroom.

And thousands of our most advanced chips went to Megaspeed and onward to China.

The Trump Administration risked our lead in Artificial Intelligence in return for a few fancy chandeliers.

Pleased to share that the House has overwhelmingly passed the #MajorRichardStarAct, which I proudly joined my colleagues in introducing.

Our combat-disabled veterans have sacrificed so much in service to our nation. This bipartisan legislation will ensure they receive the full retirement pay and disability benefits they have earned and deserve.

On #VeteransDay, we honor the brave men and women who have served our nation and defended our freedoms.

We are forever grateful for their service and sacrifice. 

Just as they have stood up for us, we must always stand by our veterans and their families, ensuring they receive the care, benefits, and support they have earned.

As Co-Chair of the Congressional CPA Caucus, I was pleased to welcome #PCAOB Chair Jim Logothetis to my office with @RepTomSuozzi and @RepSpartz.

We discussed keeping audit quality on pace with America’s largest companies and his recent trip to China to hold Chinese firms to the https://t.co/x7ONKHCQhl
Obviously, Trump did not hear the message from the American people on Tuesday night. https://t.co/2L1DWEoDSu

In 2016, President Obama signed a Memorandum of Understanding to provide Israel with military aid through 2028 – aid that is spent right here at home and supports thousands of American jobs. 

Israel faces extraordinary threats to its security and has been America's most important ally in the Middle East. Israel spends nearly four times as much on its own GDP on defense than the rest of our allies.

Donald Trump’s isolationism will only make America weaker on the world stage.

Ventura County voters: Today is Election Day!

You can drop off your completed mail-in ballot at any official ballot drop box or Vote Center. You can also visit a Vote Center to vote in person.

All locations are open until 8 PM tonight!

LA County can return ballots at any official drop box until 8 PM on Election Day. 

Find your nearest yellow box location at https://t.co/Hq9pz0y6fF https://t.co/hKGIgRNSMw
Great to address the bright students at C & E Merdinian #Armenian Evangelical School. They asked great questions and are truly the leaders of tomorrow. https://t.co/PK4RCm8Rfs

Great meeting with representatives from the Armenian Assembly of America @ARAMAC_CA today. We discussed issues important to the Armenian-American community and U.S.-Armenia relations. https://t.co/1KrzEsoyDU
As I told you: https://t.co/Eswl45D6rL https://t.co/gXHpzHvbu1
Clearly a political prosecution. https://t.co/9DQBlpA8mR

I am outraged by the anti-Indian and anti-Hindu hate that is rising across the country and impacting so many, including my friend and colleague @CongressmanRaja 

This attempt to slaughter families while they pray is the epitome of evil. We must combat anti-Indian and anti-Hindu prejudice wherever it occurs and continue strengthening the security of minority houses of worship.

China is making a huge mistake. These missile-part exports damage the economy of every country in the world. They drive up the cost of petroleum, and China is the number one importer of petroleum.

Oil bound for China from the Saudi port of Yanbu will have to circumnavigate Africa because the Houthis blockade the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
Once again, as I tweeted on Sept. 4 and Oct. 11, @RepMaxineWaters has my 💯% support, and I believe the support of the vast majority of Democrats on the @USHouseFSC committee. https://t.co/SOSKUR003B

Any regime that executes its youth and its future like this - without a fair trial and any modicum of human rights - is bound to fall. Regardless of how long it takes the people of #Iran will see the end of this regime that continues to execute its own children. 

#StopExecutionsInIran

We must immediately do more to address the existential threats that dangerous AI systems already pose.

I’m leading my colleagues in urging an immediate and significant increase in funding for AI safety. 

The $15 million currently proposed for the Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) is ridiculously inadequate to evaluate increasingly powerful AI systems.

The Justice Department is seeking to indict former Trump aide Cassidy Hutchinson for allegedly lying to Congress about Trump's actions on January 6th.

If we're going to start indicting people for lying to Congress — https://t.co/TkUjAtdFce

Three years ago today, Hamas terrorists carried out the deadliest attack against the Jewish people since the Holocaust, murdering more than 1,200 innocent people and taking some 250 hostages.

We remember the victims of October 7th, stand with their families, and remain committed to ensuring such an atrocity can never happen again.

My full statement ⤵️
https://t.co/iLAsEs8JSO
Unhinged and dangerous comments from a President who seems determined to reach a new, unimaginable low every day. https://t.co/KjbmLO0YNJ

On #MusicAdvocacyDay2026, it was good to meet with some amazingly talented music creators with the GRAMMYs @RecordingAcad. 

I’m proud to represent some of the most creative artists in the world, and they and their colleagues deserve fair compensation and property rights, particularly when AI can be used to exploit their work.

The attempted hijacking of a Dubai–Tel Aviv flight carrying hundreds of Israelis was thwarted by the extraordinary heroism of Capt. Smit Machchhar and passengers who subdued the hijacker and brought the plane to safety against incredible odds.

Thanks to the courage of Capt. Machchhar and the passengers who acted, an attempt to murder hundreds of civilians was stopped.

Welcomed new Consul General of Israel to Los Angeles @IsraelinLA, Ambassador Modi Ephraim @AmbModiEphraim

Pleased to see that @FEMA is paying California the money it owes to the state for providing caseworkers for fire victims through September 30. It is now time for FEMA to approve and fund keeping this program open at least through May of next year.

Losing one’s home in a horrendous fire is extremely difficult on families. Working through the morass of governmental and insurance issues without a caseworker would be horrendous for many families.

.@RepJudyChu and I welcomed efforts to restart talks with North Korea and urged the Trump Administration to lay the groundwork for meaningful negotiations. 

See our full statement ⤵️
https://t.co/asXM1LFw1q https://t.co/aVBB410NIb

Honored today to pay tribute to the WWII combat service of Jay J Stein (d. 2004) with the medals he earned -but was never awarded- for his service in the Po Valley campaign. 

Jay is survived and his service remembered by his son Richard (pictured here) who worked with my Constituent Service staff to ensure that the medals be awarded posthumously and provided to his family in his memory.

U.S. intelligence now assesses that Saudi Arabia has not ruled out developing a nuclear weapons program.

Last week on @PBS @NewsHour, I explained why the proposed U.S.-Saudi nuclear deal provides woefully inadequate safeguards against exactly this threat.

Watch ➡️ https://t.co/AxBfiMSw7x

Back on March 13, I first called on President Trump to use his existing authority to halt U.S. petroleum exports and help lower gas prices.

On May 7, I introduced the No U.S. Oil Exports During Iran War Act to require a suspension of U.S. oil exports and shield Americans from soaring gas prices as a result of Trump’s war with Iran.

Nice to see Trump and Republicans are finally starting to get on board. The question is whether they’ll finally act.

Today I joined @HabitatLA and volunteers in Pacific Palisades as they help wildfire survivors rebuild their homes and their community.

We must continue working at every level to help our community rebuild and return home. https://t.co/VnU45grKgP
President Trump just announced to the entire world his worst decision: a refusal to regulate AI or enter into international agreements to regulate AI. https://t.co/nRZjUcSmmh

I hope all who observed Yom Kippur had a meaningful fast and a day of reflection and renewal.

May the year ahead bring peace, health, and meaning to you and your loved ones. https://t.co/XI1aU1VCZB

I joined @PBS @NewsHour for a debate with former Obama Deputy Energy Secretary Daniel Poneman over the proposed U.S.-Saudi nuclear agreement.

I explained why Congress must act to prevent Saudi Arabia from gaining the ability to develop a nuclear weapon.

Watch our debate ⤵️ https://t.co/W9BeXC64AM

A Saudi nuclear bomb would shred a half-century of nonproliferation progress, making it critical to American national security that we prevent this dangerous deal.

Tonight, I’ll appear on @PBS @NewsHour to debate former Obama Deputy Energy Secretary Daniel Poneman, who supports the agreement, and explain why I believe this deal is so dangerous.

The most expensive way to build a White House ballroom is to say it’s free to the American taxpayer, and then sell off federal policy decisions.

Nvidia gave $25 million to the ballroom.

And thousands of our most advanced chips went to Megaspeed and onward to China.

The Trump Administration risked our lead in Artificial Intelligence in return for a few fancy chandeliers.

Pleased to share that the House has overwhelmingly passed the #MajorRichardStarAct, which I proudly joined my colleagues in introducing.

Our combat-disabled veterans have sacrificed so much in service to our nation. This bipartisan legislation will ensure they receive the full retirement pay and disability benefits they have earned and deserve.

On #VeteransDay, we honor the brave men and women who have served our nation and defended our freedoms.

We are forever grateful for their service and sacrifice. 

Just as they have stood up for us, we must always stand by our veterans and their families, ensuring they receive the care, benefits, and support they have earned.

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.

town_halls.note: There is no national town-hall dataset. Dates are not estimated.

disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
vote_scope: This is not a full career record. The cache is the latest 40 House rolls (2026, rolls 275-314) and 40 Senate votes (119th Congress, session 2, votes 217-256).
